transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm really embarrassed to admit this, but I've been struggling with eating out of control lately. I find myself consuming massive amounts of food in a very short period of time, and it feels like I just can't stop once I start. It's getting really distressing and I don't know what to do.
After these episodes of eating, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or the use of laxatives?

I don't make myself throw up or use laxatives, but I do try to compensate in other ways. I will fast and completely stop eating for long stretches, and I also force myself to exercise excessively way past my physical limits. It feels like the only way to prevent myself from gaining weight.
How do you feel about your body shape and weight, and how much do these factors influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

I honestly hate my body, and when I look in the mirror, I see myself as so much larger than I actually am. My entire self-worth is completely tied to the scale, so if I gain even a tiny bit of weight, I feel like an absolute failure as a person. I only feel okay about myself when I manage to lose weight or keep it down.
Could you please tell me your current height and weight, or describe if you are currently at a significantly low body weight for your age and height?

I'm not really sure of my exact weight right now, and I honestly don't know if it would be considered significantly low. Looking at the scale or even thinking about my actual weight makes me so anxious that I try to avoid it as much as possible.
For female patients, have you experienced any changes in your menstrual cycle, such as missing periods for three or more consecutive months?
No, I haven't experienced any missed periods or changes like that. My menstrual cycle has remained pretty regular.
On average, how many times per week would you say these episodes of binge eating and subsequent compensatory behaviors, like fasting or excessive exercise, occur?
Both the binge eating and the fasting or over-exercising happen at least once a week. This has been the pattern for me for about seven months now.
